name: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL (Xiaomi FP8)
notes: Xiaomi's MoE, 309B total / 15B active, up to 1M context. Runs on vLLM's official MiMo image (mimo-v26-aarch64-cu130, vLLM 0.29.1), which has no Ray, so the nodes join with vLLM's own multi-node mode. DeepGEMM is off and the MoE uses Marlin: both corrupt or crash on GB10 otherwise, according to two 2× Spark recipes. The older nightly image answered with nonsense.
